settings.heading: Our Restaurant
settings.subheading: Crafted with fresh seasonal Nordic ingredients and woodfire mastery.

items.name: Barents Red King Crab Consommé
items.description: Steamed red king crab cluster in clarified golden saffron broth with sea fennel.

items.name: Smoked Fjord Trout Tartare
items.description: Cold-smoked fjord trout, shallot crisps, mountain horseradish creme & dill oil.

items.name: Hardangerfjord Wild King Salmon
items.description: Crispy-skin wild salmon, cold-pressed dill oil emulsion, smoked parsnip puree & gold leaf.

items.name: Birch-Charred Wagyu Tenderloin
items.description: 45-day dry-aged Wagyu tenderloin over birch coals, black winter truffle glaze & king oyster.

items.name: Pan-Roasted Atlantic Halibut
items.description: Lofoten halibut loin basted in noisette butter, golden chanterelles & asparagus spears.

items.name: Alder-Smoked Telemark Venison
items.description: Forest venison loin roasted over alder coals, lingonberry reduction & Jerusalem artichoke.

items.name: Smoked Valrhona Cloudberry Sphere
items.description: Dark Valrhona chocolate dome, Arctic cloudberry sorbet, warm raspberry coulis & gold.

items.name: Nordic Lingonberry Mille-Feuille
items.description: Caramelized flaky pastry, vanilla bean chantilly, wild mountain lingonberry & cardamom.

items.name: Smoked Fjord Old Fashioned
items.description: Sherry-cask Linie Aquavit, single malt, torched rosemary & hand-carved monogram ice.

items.name: Arctic Cloudberry Botanical Spritz
items.description: Distilled sea buckthorn, lemon thyme, pressed wild cloudberries & elderflower tonic.
